messages:
Rina (People Ops): Dropping the all-hands follow-up thread for any review/comp/benefits items we missed. Keep questions short and tag if it's confidential.

Omar (Eng): Are calibrated band moves automatic if someone gets an "upband" recommendation, or do managers still need to submit paperwork?

Rina (People Ops): Managers must still submit the band-change form. Calibration records the recommendation; paperwork triggers payroll/HR updates. We process within two cycles.

Priya (Product): Clarify "two cycles" please — does that mean two payrolls?

Clara (Finance): Yes — if form is complete by cutoff it applies in next payroll, otherwise the following one. We'll share cutoff dates in the handbook.

Nate (Manager): For leveling conversations with ICs, any new guidance on framing "stretch" vs "ready"? New managers struggled a bit in calibration.

Rina (People Ops): Short guidance: "stretch" means expanded responsibilities + impact but not full ownership; "ready" means consistent performance at the higher level across multiple domains. We've uploaded sample conversation scripts to the manager toolkit.

Omar (Eng): Will the company change the eligibility window for off-cycle promotions? Ran into a case where someone transitioned from contractor in March.

Rina (People Ops): No policy change this cycle. Contractors converted to FTE are eligible after 90 days for normal cycles; exceptions considered case-by-case via off-cycle request.

Priya (Product): Any update on the benefits vendor change mentioned last quarter? Folks want to know open enrollment impacts.

Clara (Finance): Vendor migration is scheduled for Q3 open enrollment. Coverage won't drop; plan options might shift slightly. We'll host a benefits walkthrough the week before enrollment opens.

PeopleOpsBot: Manager toolkit link: /handbook/manager-toolkit (edited 1765554400).

Rina (People Ops): If you have confidential appeals or comp compression cases, DM me or Omar. We'll bundle examples for the next calibration retro. Thanks all.
